channel.title: Comments on: A/r/t/cart/ography: Happier, healthier, wealthier?

item.title: By: dburman1309
item.dc:creator: dburman1309
item.content:encoded:
I completely agree that our task is not to seek solutions but to more fully understand our predicament, our complicity in unsustainable/ collapsing societal, institutional and ecological conditions – many of which originated as “solutions” to a perceived problem. “Everything is awesome” leaves the door open to thought formations that those of us who critique the seducttive certainties of fascism are somehow enemies, standing in the way of progress – and must be crushed.
